originalTitle: Watch: Was Trump smuggled out of Air Force One in a catering truck?
summary: US media reports say the president secretly left via a catering truck to avoid a threat to his life from Iran.
content:
Donald Trump secretly switched planes when he was returning from a Nato meeting last month in order to avoid a threat to his life from Iran, US media has reported.

The president boarded Air Force One in Ankara, Turkey, on 8 July before being transported to another aircraft with the help of a catering truck, the Washington Post said.

He was then seen disembarking Air Force One in the UK, before boarding his newer, Qatari-gifted jet and returning to the US.

Trump spoke to journalists during his flight to the US but did not say whether he had been moved to a different plane.

The BBC's diplomatic correspondent Paul Adams explains.

More on this story: Trump hid in catering truck in secret plane swap over Iran threat, reports say
chineseTitle: 观看：特朗普是用餐车从空军一号偷运出来的吗？
chineseSummary: 美国媒体报道称，总统乘坐餐车秘密离开，以避免伊朗对他的生命构成威胁。
chineseContent:
据美国媒体报道，唐纳德·特朗普上个月从北约会议返回时秘密换机，以避免伊朗对他的生命构成威胁。

据《华盛顿邮报》报道，总统于 7 月 8 日在土耳其安卡拉登上空军一号，然后在一辆餐饮卡车的帮助下被转移到另一架飞机上。

随后有人看到他在英国走下空军一号，然后登上卡塔尔赠送的新型喷气式飞机返回美国。

特朗普在飞往美国的航班上接受了记者采访，但没有透露他是否已被转移到另一架飞机。

BBC 外交记者保罗·亚当斯解释道。

更多关于这个故事的内容：报道称，特朗普因伊朗威胁而躲在餐车里进行秘密飞机交换
